title: Dispatch console - morning triage
summary: Desktop prototype for dispatchers: triage the morning's turbine alarms, open a work order, see live readings and history, and assign the best-matching technician in one window. Tested question: can a dispatcher assign a critical fault in under a minute without phoning around?

items: Detail panel: readings, required skills, history
Job cards open the work order
First version: list, filters and detail panel.
Assign window with best match, crew board, edge states.

figmaDeviations.what: Workload shown as a bar instead of a number only
figmaDeviations.why: Dispatchers in the first session compared numbers slowly; the bar made overload visible at a glance.
